claims.statement: Culler is a local-first orchestration system for AI coding agents with one human operator that deploys onto one Mac.
Culler supports Macs with Apple silicon.
TypeScript processes spawn mc and read one JSON object from stdout; exit code 0 is success, 1 is a domain rejection, and 2 is a usage or environment error.
The dashboard binds 127.0.0.1:7333 by default.
The release fast suite includes mc, six runner components including setup-runner, resident, and dashboard.
Repository rules prohibit code references to absent documents and require short comments for tricky code.
The operator decides a review packet with exactly one of approve, revise, or cancel.
The substrate combines schema.sql, delivery.sql, and environments.sql into the current schema and computes its SHA-256 identity.
The Setup Journal keeps one current row per milestone and resets that milestone when another attempt starts.
The setup agent assesses each missing prerequisite before its final image decision and requires credible feasibility evidence for a material development benefit.
Expected image capabilities remain unverified until the approved image executes the affected commands.
The Strategist accepts at most two task proposals per batch.
Project priority belongs to an approved task; an open correction alone has no Project priority.
The Pipeline places the Project wiki section beside the task run banner, above the task path, and below the banner at narrow widths.
The Review page offers a packet conversation that also opens on the Collie page.
Setup and pipeline containers use a persistent Project home with separate temporary role directories.
The task dialog shows the unsuccessful Verifier correction count and displays the report in the correction limit alert.
Routine Verifier correction results use a neutral tone in recent runs and task history.
Ask Collie opens an ordinary conversation with the selected diagnostic issue and requests an explanation and proposed action.
The Review quick chat provides model selection that starts a new packet conversation when the selected profile differs from its current profile.
Operators open Setup history from the Project's Environment page to view its journal on the Board.
Live queue and Ledger cards identify packets by task number and task title, with the title below metadata and limited to three lines.
Reader and quick chat headings use the packet row title.
The dashboard resolves operator decision reports through a changed task description and a reason, with Cancel task as an alternative.
The browser suite runs on pull requests and main pushes, and both publication jobs require it.
Discord setup proceeds through bot validation, channel test delivery, account confirmation, and explicit dashboard approval.
The notice, issue dialog, and System health count a shared proposal decision once while preserving independent task conditions.
Repository rules permit task progress with unchanged failures and unavailable host tests outside criteria when the remaining task requirements hold.
The Review reader opens the shared task dialog through its Task control.
The host retains provider credentials and supplies temporary Culler tokens to agent containers.
Discord setup asks the operator to send only the displayed code in the selected channel.
The task dialog offers no Require decision control.
A packaged task has no Edit title and priority control in its task dialog.
The dashboard light theme uses porcelain paper, white surfaces, and navy text; its dark theme uses navy paper, dark blue surfaces, and pale text.
The dashboard shows tile lines until the operator selects the background picture, and the browser retains that selection.
The configured Discord channel starts one thread conversation per channel message, and the dashboard can continue that session.
Agent profiles can select an optional effort, and the model test checks that selection.
The role assignment dialog offers an Edit action for each enabled profile.
A published installation downloads OpenCode and its web search plugin when the first OpenCode connection requires them.
An interrupted update retries its exact candidate, permits checkpoint restoration before commit, and keeps ordinary work stopped until candidate verification succeeds.
Source deployments prepare OpenCode before activation and reuse verified packages when their inputs remain equal across unrelated commits or checkout paths.
The first source OpenCode connection uses the verified package without another download.
The exception for unavailable host checks outside criteria excludes new or changed tests, which must pass.
Unavailable criterion checks and new or changed tests use repair, an image proposal, or an operator decision according to the missing prerequisite.
Restore starts the previous release's helper before services and retains stopped work after a helper failure.
The candidate runtime check accepts the default Project image's protected spine directory while retaining the runtime access checks.
The Strategist directive requires two proposals together, excludes equivalent work, and leaves selection to the Arbiter.
The Strategist considers useful results, existing capabilities, full cost, and risk before it files proposals.
Setup preserves failed connections for retry and cleans up unused untested setup connections when another connection replaces them.
The dashboard uses recorded setup verification and excludes connections that no role uses from its issues.
The dashboard defaults to light and retains an operator theme selection across reloads and dashboard tabs.
Terminal setup offers providers before access methods and assigns connection and additional account names automatically.
The dashboard searches only OpenCode providers and preserves the selected provider summary above the key field.
Eligible tasks follow priority before repair, prior Worker work, stage, age, and task number; review capacity limits selection to live packets.
The Strategist proposal schema rejects priority values and creates proposals at priority 2.
The shared task-description skill defines the scope, requirements, and acceptance criteria for a task description.
The background picture moves separate parts after a logo click and reverses active motion after another click.
Reduced motion gives an immediate picture state change, and theme, window size, or tab selection changes settle the picture.
Setup links the host Culler skill automatically under .agents and the selected Claude Code or Codex personal skill directory, while preserving unrelated skills.
